items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing
items.claim: God instructed Moses on the law for cleansing a leper

items.quote: He shall be brought unto the priest
items.claim: A leper shall be brought to a priest for cleansing inspection

items.quote: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold, if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper
items.claim: The priest shall go outside the camp and examine whether the leprosy has healed

items.quote: Then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive and clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop
items.claim: The priest shall command procurement of two live clean birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop
items.object: two birds alive and clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop

items.quote: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water
items.claim: One bird shall be killed in an earthen vessel positioned over running water
items.mechanism: killed in an earthen vessel over running water

items.quote: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water
items.claim: The living bird and materials shall be dipped into the blood of the slaughtered bird
items.object: living bird, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop
items.mechanism: in the blood of the bird that was killed

items.quote: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field
items.claim: The priest shall sprinkle the person seven times, pronounce them clean, and release the living bird to the open field
items.object: him that is to be cleansed / the living bird
